meta.title: DoA / DoFP Routing: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Approver role, attempt DoA / DoFP Routing, and observe whether Procol refuses or omits the action.

Verify or record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants DoA / DoFP Routing to additional roles.
